meta.license_policy: CC0 / CC BY / CC BY-SA / Public domain (PD)

inaturalist.name: iNaturalist
inaturalist.public_domain: iNaturalist has no plain public-domain flag; CC0 is its public-domain option
inaturalist.taxon_match: observation.taxon.name must equal the checklist name exactly

commons.name: Wikimedia Commons
licenses: Public domain (Public domain / pd / pdm / PD-…)
commons.accepted_license_names: LicenseShortName (falling back to License / UsageTerms) matching CC0, CC BY x.y, CC BY-SA x.y, Public domain or PD-…; NC/ND/GFDL/unknown refused
commons.public_domain_attribution: PD files are labelled 'Public domain' and link to the Public Domain Mark; when the file page has no Artist/Credit the caption says 'author not stated' instead of inventing one
commons.taxon_match: full-text file search; the licence whitelist is the gate
